title: Hung Curd Protein Bowl
subtitle: A five-minute high-protein bowl, built two ways — sweet or savory.

nightPrep.label: Night Before — essential
items: Hang the yogurt (step 1) — 5 min of work, but it needs the whole night in the fridge

items.name: Full-fat yogurt, to hang (makes ~1½ cups hung curd)
Multigrain toast or makhana, to serve

method.title: Hang the curd (night before)
items: Line a colander with muslin cloth and set it over a deep bowl
Pour in {@yogurt}; tie the cloth and hang it over the bowl in the fridge overnight
By morning it's thick hung curd with ~2× the protein density
Save the drained whey for roti dough

method.title: Morning assembly
items: Unwrap the hung curd {~1½ cups} — should be thick like labneh
Divide into two adult bowls {=~¾ cup each}
Sweet: stir in {@jaggery:sweet}, add {@fruit}, top with {@hemp}, {@pumpkin}, {@almonds:bowl} and {@walnuts}
Savory: stir in {@kala-namak} and {@cumin}, top with {@cucumber}, {@coriander}, {@hemp}, {@pumpkin}, {@almonds:bowl} and {@walnuts}

method.label: Toddler bowl
items: Top with finely ground {@almonds:toddler|almonds} — no whole nuts (choking hazard)
Optional: mash in {@potato:toddler} for extra calories

method.label: Protein math
method.text: Hung curd yields ~10–12g protein per 100g. Hemp seeds add 10g per 3 tbsp. Together with nuts you're at 22–28g with zero cooking.
